translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Dos Kodbadnow ki Disas
Na sollom poron oraroy to allow't Linggu, mid undiyon to lovongngan iddos mgo ba‑ay no id pompiyod tid panoy ran no mgo pomammut.
To kod‑inguma ran dutun, nokita ran no noko‑ibpit don iddos batu no id lokkob taddot lovongngan.
Na id usok dan diyot daom, piru waa ran nokita rutun iddos bangkoy ni Disas nod Longaggon.
Laggun to notaong dan poron taddot notomanan, tigkow duwon oruwon mama no mid lohinat diyot morani ran. Dos umpak dan, golid se‑aa to koputiyoy.

Pomon to lampas no allak dan, id ounduk sikandan no noko‑uma kos bonnong dan diyot livuta. Piru id ikohiyan sikandan taddot oruwon mama to, “Mambot od nangkap kow to ma‑antoy ka‑ay't lugaa tid poomatoy?
Worad ka‑ay si Disas, su id badnow ron. Nolingow kowd bo taddot id oseng din koniyu to riyon pa sikandin to Galilea no,
sikandin no Anak to Minuvu, ko‑ilangan no id boggoy pa riyot bollad to mgo mosaasaa woy od imotayan sikandin ukit to kodpakpak diyon to krus. Piru od kovadnow en sikandin diyot iko‑otollun allow.”
Na, to norinog dan idda, nosompottan taddot mgo ba‑ay iddos id oseng ni Disas.
Id uli sikandan woy id ponudtuu ran idda riyot sopuu‑sokkad no tinodduwan din woy riyot mgo duma ran.
Iddos ngaran taddon mgo ba‑ay, si Maria no toho Magdala, si Juana woy si Maria no inoy ni Santiago. Sikandan woy dos duma pon mgo ba‑ay kos id ponudtuu riyot mgo apostoles moka‑atag taddon notomanan.
Piru kunan taddot mgo apostoles ko waa koru‑anon tat ponudtulon dan, de‑en waa ran id pongimbonnaa.

Piru si Pedro, id lungkossu po‑undiyon to lovongngan. To kod‑inguma rin dutun, id lungaung sikandin woy iyon dobbo nokita rin, iddos ogget nid bodbod taddot bangkoy ni Disas. Na, id uli sikandin no nosoobbuwan taddon notomanan.
Dos Kodpokita ni Disas diyot Oruwa taddot mgo Tinodduwan Din no id Undiyon to Emaus
To idda ra en no allow, mid undiyot bariyu to Emaus iddos oruwon tinodduwan ni Disas. Dos koriyuwoy to Emaus pomon diyot Jerusalem, mgo sopuu‑sokkad no kilometro.
To riyon pa sikandan to daan, iyon dan tongkoanan, iddos moka‑atag taddot langun no notomanan.
Laggun tid potongkooy ran, id porani si Disas woy id duma kandan.
Na nokita ran sikandin, piru iling to id soungan kos mata ran amoy dii ran od pokokilaa kandin.
Kahin Disas kandan to, “Ondan man kos tongkoanan dow?” Id soro ran sinahaw woy'd kokita riyot bonnong dan no id lanu ran.
Na iddos sokkad kandan no id ngoranan ki Cleopas, id tavak kandin no mid ungketen to, “Sikkow ra vos en ayu kos minuvu ka‑ay't Jerusalem no waa saddoo taddot nopilan pa no notomanan.”

Mid intud si Disas kandan, kahi rin to, “Mambo, ondan man bos kos notomanan?” Kahi ran to, “Iddos notomanan ki Disas no toho Nazaret. Motuus sikandin no propeta riyot kod‑ontong to Monama woy riyot kod‑ontong to mgo minuvu ukit to nonaw rin woy ukit to kodpuung din to mokososoobbu.
Dos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos duma pon mgo ponguu, id boggoy kandin diyot bollad to gubernador woy id silut kandin to kopotayan ukit to kodpakpak diyon to krus.
Sikandin en nanoy kos ko‑immanan doy nod tobbus to koubbaran ni Israel. Piru ko‑ungkay, iko‑otollu ron no allow pomon taddot kod‑imatoy kandin.
Iyon doy pe‑en nosoobbu‑i, iddos duma roy no mgo ba‑ay no id undiyon gena to lovongngan to sollom poron.
Id poolivod dan nid ponudtuu konami no worad kun dutun iddos bangkoy ni Disas. Id ikahi pe‑en sikandan no duwon kun oruwon ponolihan nid pokita kandan no id ponudtuu no no‑uyag don kun si Disas.
To norinog doy idda, duwon mandad duma roy nid undiyon, woy nokita ran no mooggot en iddos ponudtulon taddot mgo ba‑ay.”
Na kahin Disas kandan to, “Ooy koniyu! Mambot motoggas kow moho nod pomakoy taddot id ponudtuu to mgo propeta?
Id sulat dan no iddos Mesiyas, ko‑ilangan nod ukit pa to mgo kodposuppit, idda pa od posivontuhan sikandin to Monama.”
Na, id paabbotlabbot ni Disas diyot kandan iddos langun moka‑atag kandin diyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama. Id tigkanoy sikandin diyot id ponsulat ni Moises woy riyot langun no nosulat to mgo propeta.
To id inguma ron sikandan diyot bariyu nod undiyonnan dan, id ponayun si Disas no uvag kun tod ipanow ron sikandin.
Piru id owiran dan en sikandin, kahi ran to, “Owwot kad ka‑ay duma konami, su od kosagkup don man ini.” De‑en id usok don si Disas diyon to baoy duma kandan.
To id unsad don sikandan nod ka‑an, id purut sikandin to paan woy id posolomatan din idda riyot Monama. Nopongnga, id toppiktoppik din idda woy id toyyow riyot kandan.
Idda ron en, nopokes kos poomdom dan woy nokilaa ran don no si Disas bos idda. Piru tigkow ron sikandin no nowora.
Na id po‑ikohiyoy ran to, “Kuu! Udtovos monit kos ginawa ta no iling to duwon apuy laggun to id paabbotlabbot din gena iddos Nosulat no Kahit Monama to riyon ki pa to daan.”
To idda ra en no timpu, id ipanow sikandan su od poolivod diyot Jerusalem. Dutun, no‑ingumannan dan iddos sopuu‑sokkad no tinodduwan woy dos duma pa nid lolivuung.
Na, sikandan don en kos unna nid ponudtuu riyot oruwa no lammid inguma, kahi ran to, “Mooggot en no novadnow ron iddos od Longaggon, su id pokita man sikandin ki Pedro!”
Id ponudtuu mandad taddot oruwa iddos notomanan to riyon pa sikandan to daan po‑undiyot Emaus, woy ko momonnu ran nokilaa si Disas iddot kodtoppiktoppik din to paan.
Dos Kodpokita si Disas diyot mgo Tinodduwan Din
Laggun tod oituu pa sikandan moka‑atag taddon notomanan, tigkow id pokita si Disas kandan no mid lohinat diyot tongannan dan woy kahi rin to, “Iddos kosunayan, inaayun duwon to koniyu.”
Notigkawan sikandan woy novaakkan, su kunan dan ko gimukud iddos nokita ran.
Piru mid ikahi si Disas to, “Mambot novaakkan kow woy mambot id duworuwa no siyak ini?
Ontongngi row man inis bollad woy pa‑a ku. Somaddi a nikiyu amoy'd pongimbonnaa kow no konna a gimukud. Su iddos gimukud, waa lawa, piru siyak, nokita row no duwon lawa ku.”
Nopongnga rin osenga idda, id pokita rin kandan iddos bollad woy pa‑a rin.
Oray sikandan no nahaa woy nosoobbuwan taddot nokita ran. Piru dii ran pe‑en od pokopongimbonnaa ko si Disas en idda. Na id inturan din sikandan to, “Duwon koka‑an dow ruwon?”
Na, id boggayan dan sikandin to songo‑molison no tinuwog no ngaap.
Id tanggap din idda woy id ka‑an din diyot isowwan dan.

Kahi rin kandan to, “Ini en kos id oseng ku koniyu iddot nokodduma ki pa, no ko‑ilangan en nod kotuman iddos langun no nosulat moka‑atag koddi riyon to mgo Suhu ni Moises, riyot id sulat to mgo propeta woy riyot mgo Salmo.”
Na, id poma‑awang ni Disas kos mgo poomdom dan amoy od koovottan dan iddos Nosulat no Kahit Monama.
Kahin rin to, “No‑ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama, no iddos Mesiyas, ko‑ilangan nod ti‑is to kodposuppit taman to kopotayan, piru od kovadnow sikandin diyot iko‑otollun allow.

Nosulat mandad dutun no, ko‑ilangan no id ponudtuu no ukit da en kandin, od posinsyan to Monama iddos langun no minuvu nod sondit woy'd tanan to mgo saa ran. Ko‑ilangan no unna idda id ponudtuu ka‑ay't Jerusalem woy id poso‑ob diyot langun no mgo tribu ka‑ay to ampow't ingod.
Pomon to sikiyu me‑en kos nokokita taddot langun no notomanan ku, sikiyu en kos od posivonnaa moka‑atag ka‑ay.

Id popiyod ku ka‑ay't koniyu iddos Uhis no Ispiritu no id tandu to Amoy ku, piru ko‑ilangan nod aangat kow ka‑ay't Jerusalem taman tod ko‑iroomman kow to kotuusan din no id pomon diyot datas to langit.”
Dos Kodbatun ki Disas diyot Datas to Langit
Nopongnga idda, id poruma ran ni Disas diyot bariyu to Betania. To id inguma ron sikandan dutun, id poratas din kos bollad din woy id dasaa sikandin amoy'd kotanggap dan kos kopiyannoy to Monama.
Laggun tid puungan din idda, enot‑enot don sikandin od kovatun sikandin diyot datas to langit.
Na, id simba ran kandin woy id livod sikandan diyot Jerusalem duma to dakkoon kahaan.
Ipat allow, od undiyon sikandan to templo woy id posivontuhan dan kos Monama.
